responsibility: Implements the gcobol driver’s language-specific command-line rewriting and link setup. It scans decoded GCC options, tracks COBOL source files and -main/-nomain semantics, decides when to synthesize main-selection options, suppresses or adds runtime libraries such as libgcobol, libdl, and libstdc++, and runs the libgcobol spec before linking, making this the COBOL analogue of other front-end driver spec handlers rather than the compiler proper.
